purpose: Define one-to-one messaging between two explicit identities, with deterministic conversation identity and no implicit group or broadcast semantics.

topics.name: Direct Messages
topics.purpose: Define one-to-one messaging between two explicit identities, with deterministic conversation identity and no implicit group or broadcast semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Direct conversation is between exactly two explicit semantic identities.
semantics.conversation_identity_rule: Conversation identity is stable and independent of current WebRTC session.
semantics.delivery_rule: Messages are delivered over an established governed P2P channel when available.
semantics.offline_rule: No centralized offline message store is implied unless an explicit future service contract defines it.
semantics.history_rule: Local message history persistence is implementation/policy-specific and must be explicit if canonical/runtime-significant.
semantics.block_rule: Blocking a requester prevents further direct contact attempts according to the blocking contract.

invariants.rule: Messaging identity, conversation state, throttling, group governance and transport semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: direct conversation silently expands to additional participant
conversation identity tied to transient session handle
central offline store assumed without explicit service contract
blocked identity continues governed direct-message attempts
message history persistence inferred without explicit policy

references.purpose: Direct messages are a P2P messaging mode.
